description:
7/20/2024 – at around 11:58 p.m. at the intersection of SE TV Hwy and SE Brookwood Avenue.  
 This crash was vehicle versus motorcyclist  with the motorcyclist having fatal injuries . 
 Weather was clear; pavement surface was dry. 
 The crash occurred on the south side of the intersection just north of the train tracks.  
 
 
 The vehicle was in the turn lane for westbound traffic on TV Hwy to turn left/south onto SE Brookwood 
Avenue. The motorcycle was going straight/east on SE TV Hwy. The crash occurred as they were 
making the left turn with a flashing yellow light onto SE Brookwood.  The driver thought there was 
enough distance and time to make the turn.  
 Unknown if citations were issued.

7/28/2024 – at around 9:58 p.m. at the intersection of SE 10th Avenue and SE Walnut Street.  
 This crash was a four -vehicle rear end crash with suspected serious injuries.  
 Weather was clear; pavement surface was dry.  
 Driver 1 was stopped northbound on SE 10th, just south of SE Walnut St. waiting for the light and heard 
a loud crash and then felt impact to the rear of their vehicle.  
 
Driver two stated they were stopped northbound on SE 10th, just south of SE Walnut St. waiting for the 
light to turn green when an unknown vehicle rear ended their vehicle.   
 
Driver 3 was also stopped at the light at SE Walnut ST and heard a loud noise before the impact.  

Driver 4 said that the vehicle in front of them suddenly braked and they were unable to stop in time. 
Driver 4 displayed indicators of impairment and admitted to driving under the influence.  
 
Driver was arrested for DUII

7/29/2024 – at around 2:45 a.m. on E Main Street approximately 500 ft east of NE 69th Avenue.

This crash was a single vehicle roll over crash where two occupants had been ejected with suspected 
serious injuries.  
 
Weather was clear; pavement surface was dry.  
 Both occupants of the vehicle were interviewed and refused to cooperate with officers and with 
hospital staff. Officers on scene believed that the occupants were possibly intoxicated, however 
hospital staff can only obtain blood from the driver. Due to their uncooperative manner, a driver was 
not identified.  
 
Unknown if citations were issued at later date.

7/31/2024 – at around 3:02 p.m. at the intersection of SE Cornelius Pass Road and SE Frances Street.  
 
This crash was a vehicle versus pedestrian with the pedestrian having minor injuries.  
  
 Weather was clear; pavement surface was dry.  
 
The driver said they were in the right southbound lane of SE Cornelius Pass Road and stopped for a red traffic  light at SE Frances Street. They stated they had noticed the pedestrian standing on the southeast 
corner with their scooter and didn't think much about it. They said their traffic light turned green and they began going southbound and as they got through the intersection, suddenly the pedestrian was 
bouncing across the hood of their car and slamming into the windshield, shattering it, and rolling off onto the ground.  
 The pedestrian wasn't sure  what happened and guessed their pedestrian light must have been red.  
 A witness said the pedestrian was standing on the southeast corner of the intersection waiting to cross the road. Further stating as their traffic light turned green for them to go, the pedestrian left the safety of the sidewalk and began crossing the road from the east to the west across the front of the vehicles 
that now had a green traffic light to go north and southbound. The witness honked at the pedestrian to warn them not to do that, but that the pedestrian waved them off  in a manner that said they w ere 
going to go anyway. The pedestrian then used their scooter to hurry across the road and even angled 
out of the crosswalk arching across the southbound lane.  
 The pedestrian was cited for Failure to Obey Traffic Control Device

8/6/2024 – at around 8:31 a.m. at the intersection of NE Cornell Road and NE 25th Avenue.

 This crash was a vehicle versus pedestrian with the pedestrian having minor injuries.  
 Weather was clear; pavement surface was dry.  
 The pedestrian said they had just entered the crosswalk on the southeast corner of the intersection and was hit by a vehicle, which was northbound on NE 25th Ave and turning right, eastbound, onto NE Cornell Rd.  
 
The driver stated their light was green and they did not see the pedestrian crossing within the 
crosswalk.  
 
The driver was cited for Failing to Yield to a Pedestrian.  
 
Staff visited the location and did not identify a reason for a driver to fail to see a pedestrian at this location.
